notes.title: Last Resort Island - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32600816/a141684a2b4dd900fee61bdbab5afecc1996a5d5.png[/img]

Solve 96 challenging levels with unique gameplay mechanics, fend off different types of mindless zombies and create your own survival paradise!

[b]Build your settlement, solve all side quest, strategy is your key, win the Solitaire championship, defeat the flocks of mindless zombies with unique fight mechanics[/b]

[u]Grab our game with 30% discount or put it on your wishlist![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/820910/Last_Resort_Island/

Features:
[list]
[*] Fun story full of whacky slapstick humour
[*] Unique fight mechanics
[*] Hunt for exiting and creative achievements
[*] Create your own survival paradise
[*] Different types of mindless zombies
[*] 96 hand-made levels full of intriguing gameplay
[*] Build a resort for the islanders: town hall, sugar factory, candy manufacture etc.
[*] Face challenging side quests
[*] Master many different adventures
[*] Win the Solitaire championship
[*] Use Power Stones and Power Cards 
[/list]

[spoiler]Eat less tofu and play more rokaplay games! DO IT![/spoiler]

notes.title: Zombie Solitaire 2 - Chapter 3 | out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6244624/17a3d994b48ab09d0e8a4e7831ba92f453169352.jpg[/img]

The last Chapter of "Zombie Solitaire 2" is finaly out. In Chapter 3, you wake up in a hospital and your journey continues through the Orient. 

Buy it now, or put this game to your wishlist :).

http://store.steampowered.com/app/623180/Zombie_Solitaire_2_Chapter_3/

* Many small improvement's (based on community feedback)
* 100+ exciting NEW levels
* 4th instalment of the hit series "Zombie Solitaire"
* Optimized and even more challenging solitaire levels
* Lightning fast time management battles
* Premium entertainment for the whole family
* Engaging zombie tale full of fun ideas
* Numerous power-ups and useful wild cards
* Challenging Match 3 duels
* Wacky multiple-choice adventures in which your decisions influence how the story develops
* Entertaining mini games of various genres such as adventure quests and puzzles

notes.title: Trading Cards - Update
notes.content:
4 years after the release of Zombie Solitaire we took the time to add great, incredible, unblievable, brilliand and awesome trading cards to the game. Each AAA game like Zombie Solitaire should offer trading cards. We hope our community will enjoy them! We are expecting 10.000 new buyers withing the next 5 minutes! 

And if you like trading cards as well as achievements, you have to buy Zombie Solitaire 2 - Chapter 1. Braiiiinzz!!!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/623160
